_comment: Allowed public API breaks against the last release (v0.4.1). Each entry names the spec section 2 B-item whose migration note documents it. b_item null = a gap: allowed so CI passes, reported loudly, and rejected by `api_breaks.py --strict`.

entries.note: tenant_id now defaults to a sentinel so omitting it can warn (FutureWarning; strict_tenancy default flips in 0.6). Behaviour when omitted is unchanged in 0.5. Weak mapping: B19 names the warning, not the signature change.
tenant_id defaults to UNSCOPED; None now means untenanted only.

timeout= default 120.0 became the TIMEOUT_UNSET sentinel: provider deadlines are now call_timeout / connect settings; passing timeout= is a deprecation. Weak mapping: B18 covers the new deadlines, B6/spec section 8 the deprecation.
save_run_event no longer takes sequence_index; it allocates and returns it.
event_sequencer removed together with EventSequencer. PersistenceRecorder is internal in practice, but griffe sees it as public.

Static-analysis artifact: the attributes still exist at runtime but are now set in ProviderError._set_provider_fields, so griffe no longer sees them. ContextLengthExceededError now subclasses ProviderError (B10). Fix in src: declare the attributes as class-level annotations.

entries.gap: make_read_router/dendrux.http removed by the later owner decision (spec section 8). Section 2 still describes B1/B2/B18 as router hardening, so the table has no removal item. docs/upgrading-to-0.5.0.mdx documents it; add a B-item (suggest B20) so the spec and notes agree.

Embedded dashboard and the `dendrux dashboard` command removed (spec section 8). B3 describes dashboard auth that no longer exists. Documented in docs/upgrading-to-0.5.0.mdx; add a B-item (suggest B20).
Internal Typer sub-app removed; `dendrux traces RUN_ID` is now a plain command and still works (options may follow the run id). No migration note needed, but no B-item lists it.
